name: Glenville State University
tuition_note: 2026-27 WV resident tuition ($4,333/sem) + fees ($541/sem) = $9,748/yr from glenville.edu/admissions/tuition-fees. Housing room only from same page: Goodwin Hall double $3,250/sem = $6,500/yr (room only, excludes meal plan). Single/Pioneer Village rates higher.
